subject: Focus decision: Alpha3 ingress-overflow semantic recovery
body: Discovery gate rerun against runtime 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70. Selected non-duplicative target: ordered hinge-ingress overflow recovery. Source-confirmed gap: normal drain replays retained samples through continuity.onHinge(source time), but overflow branch releases/optionally arms continuity then sends latest hinge only to visual/device/engine consumers and returns. No service-level test establishes safe semantic resync after dropped history. Work will define a loss-aware resync contract/prototype/tests; no production writes.
